title: Sources detail how the Microsoft 365 outage began in Switzerland and spread as failover systems shifted traffic, leaving 80%+ of Exchange servers unresponsive (Tom Warren/The Verge)
summary: Tom Warren / The Verge: Sources detail how the Microsoft 365 outage began in Switzerland and spread as failover systems shifted traffic, leaving 80%+ of Exchange servers unresponsive — A bug took down Microsoft's email services for millions around the world. … At 9AM last Thursday, everything seemed normal.
